JEFFERSON CITY, Mo -An illegal alien from Romania has been charged by a federal grand jury with one count of wire fraud in a scheme to defraud Walmart of thousands of dollars. The U.S. District Court in Kansas City indicted 25-year-old Hozu Rostas today. According to the indictment, between February 2025 and June 2026 Rostas would carry out the scheme at various Walmarts across the country, including a store in Columbia. Rostas would use a sleight of hand technique to shortchange the store. He would select merchandise and then count out the money in separate piles. Then after the cashier counted the money Rostas would take it back, remove some of the money and give the cashier a lesser amount. He would then return the merchandise to a different store and receive full price. Rostas is believed to have taken over $150,000 from the scheme.
